text:
Ethan: hi everyone, new hire here. trying to view model-serving Grafana (https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/uf8y-model-serving) and I hit a 403. who grants access?
Nora: welcome Ethan! :tada: are you authenticating through Okta?
Ethan: yep, okta (ethan@redwood.com). browser shows I'm in, but Grafana just returns 403.
onboard-bot: Welcome! Complete the Observability access step: https://go/redwood/obs-access.
Nora: two quick checks: 1) confirm the obs-access request (it auto-triggers team mappings), 2) some dashboards live in restricted folders that need folder-level mapping. If you paste the request number I can follow up.
Ethan: submitted request #9123 - listed Grafana: model-serving, infra-latency; Datadog: model-prod; Sentry: model-service-prod.
Ravi: tagging eng-observability @Nora. I can try a manual sync of Okta groups to Grafana; if the dashboard folder has tighter permissions I'll need to bind a temporary viewer.
Nora: we default to Viewer + Comment. Edit access is owner-only. If you need panel tweaks, fork and request merge.
Ravi: tried a sync, but Grafana still returns 403 for that dashboard. Ethan can you open devtools and paste the network response id for the failed /api/dashboards/uid request?
Ethan: shows errorId graf-5a9d and message "user not authorized for dashboard".
Nora: that suggests folder-level restriction. Owner is @mica in model-platform but she's in a meeting. Ravi, can you give a 24h folder view?
Ravi: done - added Ethan to folder-viewer for uid uf8y. Hard refresh and try incognito to be safe.
Ethan: works now, can see the panels. thanks so much.
Nora: for Datadog/staging alerts, wait until the obs ticket closes. we'll add you to the "model-readers" role there.
Ethan: perfect. where's the canonical list of dashboards for new hires?
Nora: https://go/redwood/observability-dashboards - there's a "new-hire" checklist. If anything's missing add it to the obs-access form.
Ethan: thanks everyone, appreciate the fast help :rocket:
Nora: welcome aboard! ping us if any other access blocks appear.
thread_text_short: New hire Ethan hits 403 on Grafana; Nora and Ravi sync Okta and temporarily grant folder viewer; obs-access ticket covers Datadog/Sentry too.
